backend/main.mo: Defines backend actor types for markets, assets, portfolios, validation results, caching, and initializes maps, constants, authorization mixin, and stock/fiat/commodities URL lists.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing frontend changes required for updated stocks data flow using Worker0 and listing affected files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-style text mapping frontend file paths to short summaries describing their purpose and functionality.
Explains deployment failure caused by missing backend method `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret` required by the frontend.
frontend/docs/rebuild-checklist.md: Checklist outlining steps for rebuilding the frontend after backend interface or method changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base, components, utilities, and design tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point that mounts the React app and loads main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures TanStack Router routes, authentication gating, theme provider, and main application shell.
frontend/src/components/assets/AssetSear: Interactive asset search component that fetches FIAT, Commodities, and Worker0 Stocks live data and filters results.
frontend/src/components/assets/MarketTyp: Dropdown selector for choosing market type, mapping enum values to user-friendly labels.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthGate.ts: Authentication wrapper showing login prompt or profile setup before rendering protected children.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginPrompt: Presents a login landing page with Internet Identity authentication and feature highlights.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Empty file with no implemented content.
Provides the main app layout with navigation, theming, user info, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/AddHol: Form for adding a holding with quantity, purchase details, validation, and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/portfolio/Holdin: Displays a table of holdings with asset info, type badges, quantities, and purchase prices.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Dialog prompting the user to enter and save their profile name on first setup.
frontend/src/components/theme/ThemeToggl: Dropdown button allowing users to switch between light, dark, and system themes.
frontend/src/data/assetCatalog.ts: Static catalog of crypto, stock, commodity, and fiat assets used for search and selection.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddHolding.ts: Mutation hook that simulates adding a holding and invalidates portfolio queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAssetSearch.ts: Client-side asset search and optional sorting, supporting overrides and crypto-specific market cap sorting.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommoditiesVPS1.ts: Hooks to fetch, validate, and parse VPS1 commodities data using react-query, including auto-fetch logic and caching controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks to load and save the current user's profile via the backend, with react-query caching.
frontend/src/hooks/useFiatVPS1.ts: Hooks to fetch, validate, and parse VPS1 fiat FX rate data with fallback logic, caching, and auto-refresh behavior.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook handling authentication state, login, logout, and identity loading.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortfolio.ts: Fetches the user portfolio via actor, currently returning a temporary empty mock until backend support exists.
frontend/src/hooks/usePriceRefreshPlaceh: Placeholder hook that runs a periodic timer for future price-refresh integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useStocksMerged.ts: Legacy hook that fetches and merges stocks data from four VPS endpoints using 16-chunk splitting and aggregates parsed results.
frontend/src/hooks/useStocksWorker0.ts: Hooks to fetch and parse stocks from the Worker0 endpoint in a single request, including validation, caching, and refetch helpers.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes with a teal-focused palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, setting up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AddAssetPage.tsx: Provides UI to select a market type, search for an asset, and add a holding to the portfolio.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays the user's portfolio with loading, empty-state, and holdings views, plus navigation to add assets.
frontend/src/pages/FiatTestPage.tsx: Offers tools to fetch FIAT VPS1 data and display validation results with status indicators.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines TypeScript enums and interfaces for market types, assets, holdings, and portfolios.
frontend/src/utils/assetSearch.ts: Implements case-insensitive searching of assets by ticker or name.
frontend/src/utils/commoditiesParser.ts: Parses commodities JSON into Asset objects with defensive validation.
frontend/src/utils/fiatFxRatesParser.ts: Parses FX rate JSON into fiat Asset objects with error handling.
frontend/src/utils/stocksParser.ts: Converts backend stock data into Asset objects, skipping invalid entries and avoiding sorting.
frontend/src/utils/stocksWorker0Parser.t: Parses Worker0 stock responses into Asset objects without merging or sorting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routes), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them, with URL taking precedence over stored values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme tokens, fonts, colors, animations, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines current project state, requirements, and pending features for implementing backend fetching and storage of Worker0 stocks.json without batching or sorting.
